Name: PFM Better Kegs Mod
Author: Billeh007
Description:
This mod aims to enhance kegs by adding much more powerful versions of them to the game. Each tier of keg will be 2x faster than the previous tier, with the top tier keg processing all ingredients in 10 minutes. I created this mod after getting sick of how long it takes my entire large shed full of kegs to process my crops, so hopefully it'll be helpful for you too!

[b]F.A.Q.:

Q:[/b] I don't have any of the kegs! What's going on?
[b]A:[/b] The kegs should unlock when you reach level 8 farming, just like the vanilla keg. Make sure you're already that level, and if you are, leave a post for me so I can see what's going on.

[b]Q:[/b] Does this mod work with x/y/z mod?
[b]A:[/b] The easiest way to test this is to run both mods and see, since I can't answer this question for every mod. That being said, it should work with everything that PFM also works with, in theory. There may be specific mods that don't work immediately with this mod (for example, mods that add new crops but don't tag them correctly), so if you find any incompatibilities, feel free to leave a post and I'll see what I can do to fix it!

[b]Q:[/b] Does this mod work with Automate?
[b]A:[/b] By default no, but [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5038]Digus' PFMAutomate[/url] provides a super easy fix to that!﻿

[b]Q:[/b] X/y/z info mod says juice can't be made/wine is made with weeds/that this mod is broken!
[b]A:[/b] That's just a bug that I don't know how to fix. The kegs still work perfectly fine, but sometimes info mods don't quite understand it.

[b]Q:[/b] Your mod is bad and you should feel bad.
[b]A:[/b] If you're having issues with the mod, feel free to leave a post and I'll do what I can to help you.
